guitar.modelsText: ESP Explorer-style / ESP KH models / Gibson Explorer
guitar.evidence: James Hetfield's ESP Explorer-style "Iron Cross" guitars and Kirk Hammett's ESP KH signature models (and earlier Jackson/Gibson Flying V/Explorer use) are extensively documented.

tone.target: dry, chugging Palm-muted Mesa-style rhythm with scooped mids
tone.profile: dry, chugging Palm-muted Mesa-style rhythm with scooped mids
tone.summary: A high-gain signal chain utilizing a distortion/fuzz stage followed by the Recti amp model into a 4x12 cabinet, optimized for aggressive, palm-muted chugging.
corrections: make it heavier and more down-tuned

rig.name: Metallica - Sad But True - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Tight gating to eliminate hum and noise inherent in high-gain metal tones.
Slight boost to tighten the attack and ensure maximum punch for palm-muting.
blocks.gap: While a dedicated OD or Distortion might be used, Boost is chosen here to maintain clarity while maximizing output drive into the high-gain amp model.

alternatives.reason: Could provide more grit but risks muddying the tight low end.

blocks.purpose: Providing the core high-gain saturation and aggressive character needed for modern metal chugs.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is used as a general high-gain source to emulate Mesa/Boogie characteristics, though specific models like RAT or Muff might be too colored. Settings are adjusted to scoop mids and maintain tightness.

alternatives.reason: Might sound too mid-focused compared to the desired scooped tone.

blocks.purpose: Simulating the massive, scooped-mid character of a Mesa/Boogie style high-gain amplifier.
Providing a robust and punchy platform for the low end while maintaining clarity.
blocks.gap: While 'Mess 4x12' might offer more modern grit, 'UK Vintage 4x12' is chosen for its reliable power and ability to handle extreme gain without excessive mud.

alternatives.reason: A viable alternative, but UK Vintage provides a more universally aggressive foundation.

blocks.purpose: Aggressively scooping the mids and boosting bass/treble to achieve the desired modern metal 'scooped' tone.
Disabled to avoid any clean or swirling effects that contradict the aggressive rhythm tone.
Disabled to maintain maximum dryness and percussive attack.
Disabled to ensure the tone remains dry and punchy, avoiding any wash or ambience.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR for better modern metal punch and definition.

proposals.reason: Enhance low-end tightness and high-frequency articulation for modern chugs.
